senses.gloss: ch. same (cmp. בשל) to be overheated, blasted (by a hot wind).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 19:26">Targ. II Kings XIX, 26</cite> <he>דִּישְׁלוֹק</he> (not <cite ref="D01154"><he>דְּיִשְׁ׳</he></cite>); <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 37:27">Targ. Is. XXXVII, 27</cite> (h. text <he>שדפה</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1:17">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵇ</cite> top <he>בההוא דשָׁלֵיק</he> in the case of one that boils (rice), contrad. to <he>דטריף</he>.

VI, 36ᶜ</cite> top <he>שָׁלְקִין</he>, v. <cite ref="L00718"><he>לְתַת</he></cite>; a. e.—Part. pass. <he>שָׁלִיק</he>, <cite ref="U01333"><he>שְׁלִיקָא</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="U01334"><he>שְׁלִיקְתָּא</he></cite>.
